title: Top 10 OpenAPI Syntax Errors & How to Fix Them (2026)
description: Troubleshoot common OpenAPI 2.0/3.0/3.1 errors including broken $ref pointers, duplicate operationIds, unhandled status codes, and type mismatches.
excerpt: A troubleshooting index for fixing reference errors, schema syntax mismatches, and validation errors in OpenAPI.
author: rishab

content.text: OpenAPI specifications can fail validation for subtle reasons. Knowing how to diagnose and fix schema syntax errors speeds up development cycles.

rows: Ensure file path or #/components/schemas/ identifier is spelled correctly
Same operationId assigned to multiple endpoints
Ensure operationId strings are unique across the entire document
Missing title or version in info block
Add info.title and info.version strings to specification root
Status code key declared as number instead of string
Wrap status keys in quotes e.g. '200' instead of 200

faqs.question: Why must status code keys be strings in OpenAPI ('200' instead of 200)?
faqs.answer: JSON object keys must strictly be strings according to the ECMA-404 JSON standard. OpenAPI status code keys like '200' or '4XX' must be quoted string keys.
